plugins.contactsPermission: Chatterly checks which of your contacts are on the app. Numbers are hashed on your device before they are sent.

plugins.photosPermission: Chatterly needs access to your photos so you can share images.
plugins.cameraPermission: Chatterly needs camera access so you can take photos to share.

plugins.microphonePermission: Chatterly needs microphone access so you can record voice notes.
